title: Romanian Government Scholarships via the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
provider: Romanian Ministry of Foreign Affairs (through Romanian diplomatic missions)
field: All fields except medicine, dentistry and pharmacy for some categories
description: Scholarships for non-EU citizens to pursue bachelor's, master's or doctoral study at accredited Romanian public universities. Instruction is in Romanian, preceded by a preparatory language year.
amount: Full tuition, free accommodation in student halls and a monthly financial allowance

title: Romanian State Scholarships for Ethnic Romanians Abroad
description: Scholarships reserved for people of Romanian ethnic origin living outside Romania to undertake bachelor's, master's or doctoral study at Romanian public universities.
amount: Tuition-free places plus a monthly stipend and accommodation support

title: University of Bucharest Institutional Scholarships for International Students
description: Tuition reductions and merit scholarships for international students enrolled on a fee-paying basis at the University of Bucharest.
amount: Partial tuition fee reduction (varies by faculty)

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (Romania-hosted programmes)
description: Fully funded, integrated master's programmes run by a consortium of universities across at least three countries, several coordinated by or including Romanian institutions. Students apply to the individual programme consortium.
amount: EUR 1,400 per month, full tuition, insurance and travel/installation allowances

deadlines.term: 2027 intake (deadline varies by programme, Oct 2026 - Jan 2027)
